fact: 1936年7月17日军事政变原定17:01发动，后改为7月18日05:00在西属摩洛哥起事、7月19日在西班牙本土起事。政变原定速战速决，但政府保留了大部分国家控制权，内战由此开始。摩洛哥起事者枪杀189人。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Spanish Civil War
sources.quote: The uprising was intended to be a swift coup d'etat, but the government retained control of most of the country... The rebels shot 189 people.

sources.title: Wikipedia, International Brigades
sources.quote: The International Brigades were volunteer soldiers organized by the Communist International to assist the Popular Front government of the Second Spanish Republic during the Spanish Civil War.

fact: 1936年7月18日卡萨雷斯·基罗加总理拒绝CNT与UGT总工会的帮助提议，两组织宣布总罢工，开启武器库并组建民兵。巴塞罗那成为无政府主义CNT-FAI的控制区，1936年夏秋出现集体化与工厂自治。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Spanish Civil War
sources.quote: On 18 July, Casares Quiroga refused an offer of help from the CNT and Union General de Trabajadores (UGT), leading the groups to proclaim a general strike. They opened weapons caches, some buried since the 1934 risings, and formed militias.

fact: 1936年7月内战爆发后，西班牙第二共和国分裂为共和派（马德里、巴塞罗那）与国民派（佛朗哥）。共和派内部派系复杂：人民阵线政府、CNT-FAI无政府主义者、POUM马克思主义统一工人党、西班牙共产党。POUM于1937年6月被内格林政府取缔，斯大林支持。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Spanish Civil War
sources.quote: The POUM fought in the Spanish Civil War from 17 July 1936 until 16 June 1937, when the POUM was illegalized and suppressed by the Popular Front Republican government led by Prime Minister Juan Negrin, with the government suppression of the POUM supported by Joseph Stalin.

fact: 1936年9-10月，西班牙共和国政府在财政部长胡安·内格林推动下，将510吨黄金（约占西班牙银行黄金储备72.6%）从马德里经铁路运至卡塔赫纳海军基地，再海运至苏联莫斯科保管，用于购买苏联武器。其余193吨黄金（约27%）运往法国换成货币，史称巴黎黄金。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Moscow Gold
sources.quote: The Moscow Gold was 510 tonnes (16,000,000 ozt) of gold, corresponding to 72.6% of the total gold reserves of the Bank of Spain, that were transferred from their original location in Madrid to the Soviet Union a few months after the outbreak of the Spanish Civil War. This transfer was made by order of the government of the Second Spanish Republic, presided over by Francisco Largo Caballero, through the initiative of his Minister of Finance, Juan Negrin.

fact: 1936年内战中，共和派获得苏联T-26坦克与飞机；国民派获得德国（秃鹰军团）与意大利支持。11月9日国际纵队第十一旅在卡萨德坎波阻击国民派摩洛哥部队；11月19日大学城战役中杜鲁蒂被射杀。

sources.title: Wikipedia, International Brigades
sources.quote: On 9 November 1936, the XI International Brigade—comprising 1,900 men from the Edgar Andre Battalion, the Commune de Paris Battalion and the Dabrowski Battalion, together with a British machine-gun company—took up position at the Casa de Campo... On 19 November, the anarchist militias were forced to retreat, and Nationalist troops—Moroccans and Spanish Foreign Legionnaires, covered by the Nazi Condor Legion—captured a foothold in the University City.

fact: 1936年11月马德里围城开始后，城内约4万共和派军队与平民据守，国民派从卡萨德坎波与大学城方向进攻。围城造成物资消耗与平民伤亡；黄金运苏后共和国财政被苏联绑定。具体配给量与物价数据未在本包取得系统统计，列为资料缺口。

sources.title: Wikipedia, International Brigades
sources.quote: Of the 40,000 Republican troops in the city, the foreign troops numbered less than 3,000... The Nationalist leaders had to renounce the idea of a direct assault on Madrid, and prepare for a siege of the capital.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Moscow Gold
sources.quote: The remaining quarter of the Bank's gold reserves, 193 tonnes (6,200,000 ozt), was transported and exchanged into currency in France.

fact: 1936年7月后，巴塞罗那CNT-FAI控制区出现工厂集体化、商店与旅馆工人自治。外国记者（海明威、奥威尔等）与国际纵队志愿者在马德里与巴塞罗那形成战地经济。穿越者若有记者、翻译或医疗技能，可在1936年内战中获得生存与收入，但须写明：内战是政治暴力，不写英雄叙事。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Spanish Civil War
sources.quote: On 18 July, Casares Quiroga refused an offer of help from the CNT and UGT, leading the groups to proclaim a general strike.

fact: 1936年11月马德里大学城战役中，无政府主义领袖杜鲁蒂被射杀；共和派内部在1937年5月巴塞罗那事件中发生冲突（POUM与CNT被政府镇压）。穿越者须将内战视为环境风险，不选边站队。

sources.title: Wikipedia, International Brigades
sources.quote: Anarchist leader Buenaventura Durriti was shot there on 19 November 1936 and died the next day.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Spanish Civil War
sources.quote: The POUM was illegalized and suppressed by the Popular Front Republican government... supported by Joseph Stalin.

fact: 1936年巴塞罗那原计划承办人民奥运会（Olimpíada Popular），作为反法西斯抗议对抗柏林奥运会，会期原定7月19-26日。内战爆发后运动会取消，部分运动员留西加入民兵。

sources.title: Wikipedia, People's Olympiad
sources.quote: The People's Olympiad was a planned international multi-sport event that was intended to take place in 1936 in Barcelona, Catalonia, Spanish Republic. It was conceived as an anti-fascist protest event against the 1936 Summer Olympics being held in Berlin... With the outbreak of the Spanish Civil War just as the games were to begin, the games were hastily cancelled.

fact: 1936年11月佛朗哥国民派军队推进至马德里郊区。11月9日国际纵队第十一旅在卡萨德坎波阻击国民派；11月13日第十二旅投入战斗；11月19日大学城战役爆发，杜鲁蒂被射杀。国民派放弃直接攻城，转为围城。

sources.title: Wikipedia, International Brigades
sources.quote: On 9 November 1936, the XI International Brigade... took up position at the Casa de Campo... On 13 November, the 1,550-man strong XII International Brigade... deployed... On 19 November, the anarchist militias were forced to retreat, and Nationalist troops... captured a foothold in the University City... The Nationalist leaders had to renounce the idea of a direct assault on Madrid, and prepare for a siege of the capital.

fact: 1936年黄金运苏后，共和国财政被苏联绑定，用于购买苏联武器；剩余193吨黄金运往法国换成货币。共和派控制区外汇与物资状况在围城期间加剧紧张。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Moscow Gold
sources.quote: The remaining quarter of the Bank's gold reserves, 193 tonnes (6,200,000 ozt), was transported and exchanged into currency in France, an operation which is also known by analogy as the Paris Gold.
